content: Incorporating this visual information onto the traditional NER system is an open challenge, and multiple approaches can be considered. For instance, one may provide visual contexts only as an initial input to decoder as in some encoder-decoder image captioning systems BIBREF26 . However, we empirically observe that an NER decoder which takes as input the visual embeddings at every decoding step (Section SECREF4 ), combined with the modality attention module (Section SECREF5 ), yields better results.
